sets.title: Cloud requirements, code, dependencies and configuration

questions.question: A cloud application serves users worldwide. Which two design requirements are explicitly identified in the module?

options.A: Elastic scalability and high availability
options.B: Region-independent compliance requirements
options.C: Global reach
options.D: Fixed-capacity provisioning as the default

questions.explanation: Doküman global erişim ile elastik ölçekleme ve yüksek erişilebilirliği vurgular. Sabit kapasite önermez; veri konumu gereksinimi kullanım senaryosuna göre değişebilir.

questions.question: How should external packages and their versions be managed?

options.A: Commit external package binaries to the code repository
options.B: Leave package versions unspecified to simplify deployment
options.C: Declare versions and install with a dependency manager
options.D: Install dependencies manually without declaring them

questions.explanation: Harici paketler sürümleriyle bildirilir ve paket yöneticisiyle kurulur; JAR veya paket dosyalarını kaynak repoya koymak önerilmez.

questions.question: Which configuration method allows the same tested code to move between environments?

options.A: Environment variables
options.B: Different binaries with embedded settings for test and production
options.C: Source-code constants rebuilt per environment
options.D: A separate hard-coded configuration branch per environment

questions.explanation: Konfigürasyonu ortam değişkenleriyle geçirmek, kod değişmeden geliştirme/test/üretim ayarlarının değiştirilmesini sağlar.

questions.question: What is the stated benefit of keeping application code in a version-controlled repository?

options.A: Tracking changes and enabling CI/CD systems
options.B: Replacing the need for release automation
options.C: Automatically installing every external dependency
options.D: Guaranteeing that all committed changes pass production tests

questions.explanation: Repo değişiklik takibini ve CI/CD kurulmasını destekler; testleri veya bağımlılık yönetimini ortadan kaldırmaz.

questions.question: A compliance rule requires user data to stay in a specific region. Which cloud-design concern does this illustrate?

options.A: Security and compliance requirements
options.B: Stateless worker lifecycle requirements
options.C: Dependency isolation requirements
options.D: Caching and content-distribution requirements

questions.explanation: Sayfa 2 güvenlik ve uyumluluk nedeniyle kullanıcı verisinin belirli bir bölgede izole edilmesi gerekebileceğini söyler.

sets.title: Microservices, asynchronous operations and loose coupling

questions.question: How should microservice boundaries be chosen according to the module?

options.A: Match database-table boundaries exclusively
options.B: Match programming-language boundaries
options.C: Match business boundaries
options.D: Match deployment-server boundaries

questions.explanation: Mikroservis sınırları iş alanı sınırlarıyla eşleşir; amaç rastgele küçük dosya veya sunucu bölümleri oluşturmak değildir.

questions.question: Which two properties distinguish the described microservices from a monolith?

options.A: All dependent services must release simultaneously
options.B: Services can be deployed independently
options.C: All services must maintain one shared scaling limit
options.D: Services can scale independently

questions.explanation: Her servis ayrı güncellenir, test edilir, dağıtılır ve yüküne göre ölçeklenir. Monolitte küçük bir değişiklik bütün uygulamayı etkileyebilir.

questions.question: An uploaded image needs processing without blocking the user interface. Which design matches the example?

options.A: Upload to Cloud Storage and trigger a Cloud Run function or service
options.B: Process the image synchronously before returning the upload response
options.C: Store the image in Cloud SQL and wait for an administrator to process it
options.D: Keep the image only in frontend memory until a batch server is available

questions.explanation: Örnekte yükleme Cloud Storage'a yapılır; olayın tetiklediği Cloud Run işlemi sonucu başka bir Storage konumuna yazar.

questions.question: Why place a message queue between an order service and an inventory service?

options.A: Decouple the services and buffer traffic spikes
options.B: Force publishers to wait for all subscribers before accepting work
options.C: Make service contracts unnecessary
options.D: Guarantee that consumers never need retry logic

questions.explanation: Kuyruk gevşek bağlılık, asenkron işleme ve ani yükü tamponlama sağlar; eşzamanlı erişilebilirlik bağımlılığını artırmaz.

questions.question: An email service receives name, age and email in a customer API response. Which fields should it bind to if only addressing an email?

options.A: Name and email
options.B: Every returned field, including age
options.C: Only email, while rejecting any payload containing additional fields
options.D: All current and future fields in a strict shared response class

questions.explanation: Tüketici ihtiyaç duyduğu alanlara bağlanır. Gereksiz alanlara sıkı bağlanmak API'nin geriye uyumlu evrimini zorlaştırır.

sets.title: Stateless workers, retry and circuit breakers

questions.question: Where should a scalable Cloud Run worker persist application data in the module's example?

options.A: The container's local filesystem as the only durable copy
options.B: Shared mutable process state held by another worker
options.C: A separate database such as Firestore
options.D: Worker-local memory replicated manually to every new instance

questions.explanation: Worker hesaplama yapar; kalıcı veri Firestore gibi ayrı veritabanına gider. İç durum bağımlılığı örneklerin kaldırılmasını zorlaştırır.

questions.question: Which two lifecycle properties help stateless workers scale reliably?

options.A: Keep durable application state only in instance memory
options.B: Shut down gracefully on a termination signal
options.C: Delay startup until every other worker has started
options.D: Start quickly

questions.explanation: Hızlı başlangıç ve sonlandırma sinyalinde düzgün kapanış ölçeklemeyi destekler; kalıcı durum için başka bir worker'a bağımlılık önerilmez.

questions.question: Which response is recommended for transient network failures?

options.A: Retry indefinitely without a final failure path
options.B: Retry with exponential backoff
options.C: Apply a circuit breaker permanently after the first transient failure
options.D: Retry continuously with a constant zero delay

questions.explanation: Üstel geri çekilme backend veya ağı tekrarlarla aşırı yüklemeyi önler; hata sürerse düzgün biçimde başarısız olunmalıdır.

questions.question: A downstream service has a long-lasting outage. What mechanism prevents wasted retries and CPU cycles?

options.A: Increase worker count to generate more retries
options.B: Keep a synchronous request open until the service recovers
options.C: Retry with shorter intervals after every failure
options.D: A circuit breaker

questions.explanation: Uzun süreli kesintide circuit breaker gereksiz istek üretimini durdurur; sürekli hızlanan tekrarlar sorunu büyütür.

questions.question: The recommendation engine is unavailable. Which user-facing response illustrates graceful degradation?

options.A: Return a fatal error for the whole page
options.B: Require users to reload until the engine recovers
options.C: Hide the recommendation section temporarily
options.D: Retry indefinitely before rendering any other content

questions.explanation: Dokümanın örneği, her sayfada hata göstermek yerine öneri bölümünü geçici olarak gizlemektir.

sets.title: Caching, API gateways and federated identity

questions.question: What should happen after a cache miss and recomputation?

options.A: Return the result and update the cache
options.B: Invalidate the whole database to force a cache hit
options.C: Return the result without ever refreshing the cache
options.D: Retry the same cache lookup indefinitely without fetching backend data

questions.explanation: Cache miss durumunda veri backend'den alınır/hesaplanır ve yeni değer cache'e yazılır; cache hit doğrudan cache'den karşılanır.

questions.question: Which service is described as managed in-memory application caching with Redis or Memcached?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Cloud CDN
options.C: Memorystore
options.D: Bigtable

questions.explanation: Memorystore uygulama verisini bellek içinde cache'ler; Cloud CDN ise web içeriğini edge ağı üzerinden kullanıcılara yaklaştırır.

questions.question: Which two benefits or capabilities are attributed to Cloud CDN?

options.A: Authenticate end users through federated identity providers
options.B: Cache frontend content from supported backends
options.C: Serve content closer to users through Google's edge network
options.D: Provide durable transactional storage for all application state

questions.explanation: CDN frontend içeriğinin dağıtımını hızlandırır. Veritabanı veya kullanıcı kimlik yönetimi servisi değildir.

questions.question: A legacy backend cannot be migrated. Which service can provide a modern proxy facade with quotas, rate limits and analytics?

options.A: Cloud Load Balancing as a full API-management platform
options.B: Cloud Endpoints as an application database
options.C: Cloud CDN as a legacy-protocol translator
options.D: Apigee

questions.explanation: Apigee backend API'lerinin önüne proxy katmanı koyar; güvenlik, kota, hız sınırlama ve analitik sağlar.

questions.question: Why delegate user authentication to external identity providers?

options.A: Make all user data publicly accessible without identity checks
options.B: Require users to authenticate with the application's shared service-account key
options.C: Eliminate every application-level authorization check
options.D: Avoid implementing, securing and scaling a proprietary authentication system

questions.explanation: Federated identity kullanıcı doğrulama yükünü azaltır. Uygulamanın yetkilendirme gereksinimlerini ortadan kaldırmaz.

sets.title: Logging, CI/CD and incremental migration

questions.question: How should a serverless application handle logs?

options.A: Rotate and archive log files inside each disposable instance
options.B: Retain logs only in instance-local memory
options.C: Send logs only during graceful shutdown
options.D: Write events to stdout and let infrastructure collect them

questions.explanation: Loglar olay akışıdır; stdout'a yazılıp altyapıda toplanır. Her instance'ın dosya yönetmesi önerilmez.

questions.question: What event starts the example continuous-integration process?

options.A: An operations team scheduling a monthly deployment
options.B: A code update triggers a build and automated tests
options.C: Manual approval of a production release
options.D: Promotion of an existing image without a source change

questions.explanation: CI kaynak kod güncellemesi sonrasında build ve otomatik testleri çalıştırır; üretim onayı farklı bir aşamadır.

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes continuous deployment from continuous delivery in this module?

options.A: Continuous delivery automatically skips all production approvals
options.B: Validated changes reach production automatically without a manual release-validation step
options.C: Continuous delivery cannot generate deployable artifacts
options.D: Continuous deployment requires a manual approval for every release

questions.explanation: Delivery doğrulanmış kodu dağıtıma hazır tutar; deployment başarılı değişikliği otomatik üretime taşır.

questions.question: Which mapping of pipeline responsibilities is correct?

options.A: Cloud Deploy runs source control; Cloud Build stores databases; GKE signs users in
options.B: Artifact Registry builds; Cloud Deploy stores images; Cloud Build serves production traffic
options.C: Cloud Build builds; Artifact Registry stores artifacts; Cloud Deploy manages delivery
options.D: Cloud Build and Artifact Registry both exclusively manage application runtime scaling

questions.explanation: Üç ürünün rolü build, artifact saklama ve dağıtım olarak ayrılır. Canary ve blue-green üretime geçiş riskini azaltabilir.

questions.question: How does the strangler pattern reduce migration risk?

options.A: Keep every legacy feature and its replacement running permanently without changing routing
options.B: Replace the entire legacy application before routing any production traffic
options.C: A facade gradually routes functionality from the legacy application to new services
options.D: Move all services simultaneously and validate afterward

questions.explanation: Facade eski ve yeni uygulamaya yönlendirir; özellikler aşamalı taşınır. Toptan değişim zorunlu değildir.

sets.title: Cloud APIs, SDK and command-line tools

questions.question: Which two interfaces are explicitly supported for Cloud API calls?

options.A: SOAP-only requests for all services
options.B: Direct SQL connections to every Google Cloud API
options.C: gRPC requests
options.D: HTTP requests with JSON payloads

questions.explanation: Cloud API'leri HTTP/JSON ve gRPC üzerinden çağrılabilir; hassas kaynaklara erişimde kimlik bilgileri gerekir.

questions.question: How does the module describe the relationship between the SDK and Cloud APIs?

options.A: Cloud Client Libraries contain the complete SDK command-line toolchain
options.B: Installing the SDK replaces the need for application credentials
options.C: SDK tools and libraries use Cloud APIs
options.D: Cloud APIs are implemented inside each application's SDK installation

questions.explanation: SDK komut satırı araçlarını ve dil kütüphanelerini içerir; bunlar servislerle Cloud API'leri üzerinden konuşur.

questions.question: Which command lists VM instances in the active project?

options.A: gcloud compute instances list
options.B: gcloud storage buckets list
options.C: gcloud components list
options.D: gcloud compute instance-templates list

questions.explanation: `gcloud compute instances list` VM listesini verir; components kurulu araçları, storage buckets bucket'ları listeler.

questions.question: Which command-line tool primarily runs BigQuery queries?

options.A: bq
options.B: gcloud storage
options.C: gsutil
options.D: kubectl

questions.explanation: bq BigQuery sorguları ve dataset/table yönetimi içindir; kubectl Kubernetes'i yönetir.

questions.question: Which two component-management commands match the module?

options.A: gcloud component install kubectl
options.B: gcloud components install kubectl
options.C: gcloud components update
options.D: gcloud compute components update

questions.explanation: `components install` araç ekler, `components update` CLI sürümünü günceller; component list durumları gösterir.

sets.title: Cloud Client Libraries and local SDK setup

questions.question: Which two tasks do Cloud Client Libraries handle automatically?

options.A: Authentication plumbing
options.B: Assigning IAM roles automatically
options.C: Selecting database schemas automatically
options.D: Retry logic for transient network failures

questions.explanation: Kütüphaneler düşük seviye kimlik doğrulama ve retry işlemlerini kolaylaştırır; IAM yetkilerini kendiliğinden yükseltmez.

questions.question: What does idiomatic mean in the description of Cloud Client Libraries?

options.A: Wrapping every API call only as a shell command
options.B: Using only raw HTTP strings instead of language-specific objects
options.C: Requiring identical method names and syntax across all languages
options.D: Following each programming language's natural conventions and style

questions.explanation: Idiomatic dilin doğal stilini kullanmaktır. Kütüphanelerin SDK'nin tamamını içerdiği anlamına gelmez.

questions.question: What can give many Cloud Client Libraries a performance benefit?

options.A: Using only synchronous browser requests
options.B: Using gRPC APIs internally
options.C: Disabling retry logic by default
options.D: Skipping server-side authorization checks

questions.explanation: Doküman birçok kütüphanenin gRPC API'lerini otomatik kullanmasından gelen performans yararını belirtir.

questions.question: In the Python bucket-creation example, which storage class is assigned before creating the bucket?

options.A: NEARLINE
options.B: COLDLINE
options.C: ARCHIVE
options.D: STANDARD

questions.explanation: Örnekte `bucket.storage_class = "NEARLINE"` atanır ve bucket `location="us"` ile oluşturulur; soru bu kod örneğine özeldir.

questions.question: Which command initializes the installed SDK configuration?

options.A: gcloud auth application-default login
options.B: gcloud init
options.C: gcloud config list
options.D: gcloud components update

questions.explanation: SDK Linux, macOS ve Windows'a kurulabilir; başlangıç yapılandırması `gcloud init` ile yapılır.

sets.title: Cloud Shell, Cloud Code, emulators and Workstations

questions.question: Which Cloud Shell resource persists across replacement session VMs according to the course?

options.A: The complete VM root filesystem indefinitely
options.B: An unlimited persistent home directory
options.C: The running VM and all its processes indefinitely
options.D: 5 GB of persistent disk storage

questions.explanation: Cloud Shell geçici VM sağlar; 5 GB kalıcı disk yeni oturum VM'lerinde korunur. VM'nin kendisi kalıcı değildir.

questions.question: Which two Cloud Code capabilities are explicitly listed?

options.A: Replacing every cloud service with a local emulator
options.B: Local Cloud Run debugging with an emulator
options.C: Managing all production IAM permissions without configuration
options.D: Kubernetes YAML autocomplete and inline documentation

questions.explanation: Cloud Code Kubernetes YAML yazım desteği ve Cloud Run yerel çalıştırma/debug özellikleri sunar.

questions.question: How can an application switch from a supported local emulator to the actual cloud service without rewriting business code?

options.A: Replace every library call with a direct REST request
options.B: Create a separate production codebase for each emulator
options.C: Recompile the application for a different programming language
options.D: Change the relevant environment configuration used by the client library

questions.explanation: Belirtilen ortam değişkenleri client library'nin emulator veya bulut endpoint'ine bağlanmasını belirler.

questions.question: Which command group manages the local service emulators described in the module?

options.A: gcloud beta emulators
options.B: gcloud components emulator-config
options.C: gcloud emulators production
options.D: gcloud compute emulators

questions.explanation: Doküman emulator kurulum/yönetimi için `gcloud beta emulators` grubunu verir; geliştirme bulut kaynakları tüketmeden yapılabilir.

questions.question: Which two properties describe Cloud Workstations?

options.A: Developers can connect through a browser, SSH or a local IDE
options.B: The IDE and code run inside the VPC
options.C: Every environment must run entirely on the developer's laptop
options.D: Only a browser can access the environment; SSH and local IDEs are excluded

questions.explanation: Workstations yönetilen, tekrarlanabilir geliştirme ortamıdır; IDE ve kod VPC içinde çalışır ve çeşitli istemcilerden erişilir.

sets.title: Cloud Storage and Firestore

questions.question: Which property identifies a Cloud Storage object when retrieving it in this module?

options.A: A disk block address exposed to the application
options.B: Its object name
options.C: A relational primary-key join
options.D: A document collection path with indexed field queries

questions.explanation: Object Storage nesneyi adıyla alır; içerik yapılandırılmamış baytlar olarak değerlendirilir, ilişkisel join modeli değildir.

questions.question: What is the maximum individual object size stated in the uploaded Cloud Storage slide?

options.A: 64 TB
options.B: 5 TB
options.C: 1 MB
options.D: 5 GB

questions.explanation: Yüklenen slayt nesne başına 5 TB belirtir. Bu soru PDF sürümündeki değeri ölçer; bucket toplam kapasitesiyle karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: Which two features make Firestore suitable for mobile and web applications?

options.A: Real-time updates
options.B: A fixed relational schema required for every document
options.C: Mandatory management of database-server VMs
options.D: Offline features

questions.explanation: Firestore serverless NoSQL doküman veritabanıdır; gerçek zamanlı güncelleme ve offline özellikler mobil/web senaryolarına uygundur.

questions.question: Which data model is explicitly associated with Firestore?

options.A: Hierarchical collections and documents
options.B: Block addresses in a virtual disk
options.C: Only immutable binary blobs with metadata
options.D: A relational table-and-join schema

questions.explanation: Firestore koleksiyon ve doküman temellidir. Object Storage blob, blok depolama ise disk blokları kullanır.

questions.question: In the bookshelf lab, which pairing of data and storage is specified?

options.A: Book data in Firestore and cover images in Cloud Storage
options.B: Book data in BigQuery and images in the application container
options.C: Book data in Cloud Storage and cover images in Firestore documents
options.D: Both book records and images only in worker-local files

questions.explanation: Laboratuvar kitap verisini Firestore'a, kapak görsellerini Cloud Storage bucket'ına yerleştirir.

sets.title: Bigtable and Cloud SQL

questions.question: Which combination describes Bigtable's storage model?

options.A: A PostgreSQL-compatible relational database
options.B: A serverless OLAP data warehouse
options.C: A Redis-compatible in-memory cache
options.D: A sparse wide-column NoSQL table

questions.explanation: Bigtable seyrek, geniş sütunlu NoSQL tablodur; milyarlarca satır ve binlerce sütuna ölçeklenebilir.

questions.question: Which workload best matches the Bigtable use cases listed in the module?

options.A: A relational application requiring frequent multi-table joins
options.B: An application requiring automatic end-user offline synchronization
options.C: Large amounts of single-keyed data with high read/write throughput
options.D: A small transactional dataset requiring multi-row relational transactions

questions.explanation: Tek anahtarlı büyük veri, yüksek throughput ve düşük gecikme Bigtable kullanımına uyar; ilişkisel/transactional ihtiyaçlar aynı şey değildir.

questions.question: Which three database engines are named for Cloud SQL?

options.A: SQL Server
options.B: MySQL
options.C: Oracle
options.D: PostgreSQL

questions.explanation: Cloud SQL için bu üç ilişkisel motor listelenir; Redis cache motorudur, Oracle bu listede yoktur.

questions.question: Which tasks does the module explicitly say Google manages for Cloud SQL?

options.A: Only the database user interface, with replication managed entirely by the customer
options.B: Business schema design, query semantics and application transactions
options.C: Replication, failover and backups
options.D: Every change to the application's data-access source code

questions.explanation: Yönetilen operasyonlar replikasyon, failover ve backup'tır; uygulama şeması ve iş mantığı müşteri sorumluluğunda kalır.

questions.question: Which component is named for easy and secure access to Cloud SQL instances?

options.A: Cloud Router
options.B: AlloyDB Auth Proxy
options.C: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
options.D: Identity-Aware Proxy

questions.explanation: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy güvenli instance erişimi için belirtilir; CDN, tracing veya scheduling aracı değildir.

sets.title: AlloyDB and Spanner

questions.question: Which engine compatibility is central to AlloyDB?

options.A: HBase
options.B: MySQL
options.C: SQL Server
options.D: PostgreSQL

questions.explanation: AlloyDB PostgreSQL uyumluluğuna odaklanır. Cloud SQL'in üç motoruyla veya Bigtable'ın modeliyle karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: Which two AlloyDB properties are listed?

options.A: Separate compute and storage
options.B: Mandatory coupling of all compute and storage into one fixed VM
options.C: A Columnar Engine for fast-response analytics
options.D: Only unstructured object storage with no transactions

questions.explanation: AlloyDB compute/storage ayrımı ve analitik için Columnar Engine sunar; HTAP işlemsel ve analitik kullanımı birleştirir.

questions.question: What workload acronym is explicitly associated with AlloyDB?

options.A: Key-value caching without durable relational storage
options.B: OLAP without any transactions
options.C: HTAP
options.D: Only online transaction processing with no analytics

questions.explanation: HTAP, hybrid transactional/analytical processing anlamına gelir; hem transaction hem analiz gerektiren uygulamalar hedeflenir.

questions.question: Which two properties are central to Spanner's description?

options.A: Strong transactional consistency
options.B: A fixed single-server capacity with no horizontal scaling
options.C: Horizontal scalability with global reach
options.D: Eventual consistency as its only consistency model

questions.explanation: Spanner ilişkisel modeli güçlü tutarlılık ve yatay/global ölçekleme ile birleştirir.

questions.question: Which SLA figure appears on the uploaded Spanner overview slide?
questions.explanation: Slaytta 99.999% SLA gösterilir. Soru yüklenen genel bakış slaydını ölçer; belirli gerçek konfigürasyon için koşulsuz SLA garantisi olarak kullanılmamalıdır.

sets.title: BigQuery, Memorystore and storage comparisons

questions.question: Which workload is BigQuery primarily designed for in this module?

options.A: Request-by-request sub-millisecond caching
options.B: A mobile client's offline document synchronization
options.C: A globally distributed OLTP system needing per-transaction consistency
options.D: OLAP analytics and BI reporting

questions.explanation: BigQuery serverless analitik veri ambarıdır; OLAP, veri keşfi ve BI raporlama hedeflenir.

questions.question: Which three capabilities are explicitly included in the BigQuery description?

options.A: Geospatial analysis
options.B: Federated end-user authentication
options.C: Business intelligence
options.D: Automatic VM operating-system patching

questions.explanation: ML, geospatial analiz ve BI BigQuery özellikleri olarak listelenir; diğer ikisi farklı hizmet alanlarıdır.

questions.question: Which two caching engines does the uploaded Memorystore slide identify?

options.A: Memcached
options.B: PostgreSQL
options.C: Redis
options.D: SQL Server

questions.explanation: Kaynak sürümü Redis ve Memcached ile protokol uyumluluğunu belirtir; ilişkisel motorları cache motoru diye listemez.

questions.question: In the comparison table, which product is assigned very low, sub-millisecond latency?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Firestore
options.C: BigQuery
options.D: Memorystore

questions.explanation: Tabloda Memorystore sub-ms, BigQuery saniye, Cloud Storage yüzlerce ms, Firestore onlarca ms olarak verilir; bunlar kaynak karşılaştırmasıdır, SLA değildir.

questions.question: Must one application use a single database product for every kind of data?

options.A: Yes; one storage product must handle every data type
options.B: Yes; choosing Firestore excludes Cloud Storage images
options.C: No; choose the most suitable product for each need
options.D: Yes; using object storage prevents using a database

questions.explanation: Modül tek veritabanı zorunluluğu koymaz. Bookshelf örneği Firestore ve Cloud Storage'ı birlikte kullanır.

sets.title: IAM principals, permissions and roles

questions.question: What three elements does an IAM access decision connect?

options.A: User, password and browser session
options.B: Service account, API key and OAuth client ID
options.C: Project, region and billing quota
options.D: Principal, role and resource

questions.explanation: IAM 'kim, hangi kaynakta, hangi erişime sahip' ilişkisini kurar. Rol izin koleksiyonudur.

questions.question: Which two entries are valid IAM principal types in the module?

options.A: Service account
options.B: Cloud Storage bucket
options.C: Compute Engine instance
options.D: Google group

questions.explanation: Service account uygulama kimliği, Google group kullanıcı/service account grubudur; nesne adı ve makine tipi principal değildir.

questions.question: Which permission syntax matches the course?

options.A: service.verb.resource
options.B: resource.service.verb
options.C: role.principal.permission
options.D: service.resource.verb

questions.explanation: Örnek `pubsub.subscriptions.consume`; servis, kaynak türü ve fiilden oluşur.

questions.question: How are permissions granted to a user according to the role model?

options.A: Grant each standalone permission directly without using a role
options.B: Add the user to every project automatically
options.C: Grant a role containing the permissions
options.D: Encode the desired permission into the user's email address
