questions.explanation: Kaynak sürümü instance başına bir GPU ve scale-to-zero özelliği verir; inference, video transcoding ve rendering örneklenir.

questions.question: What do all Cloud Run deployment types described here ultimately produce?

options.A: A container image running on managed infrastructure
options.B: A Kubernetes cluster the developer must administer
options.C: Only source code interpreted directly without containers
options.D: A VM image with a customer-managed OS

questions.explanation: Container, source, function ve repository akışlarının sonucu yönetilen altyapıda çalışan container image'dır.

sets.title: Functions, jobs and compute-platform selection

questions.question: Which two use cases are explicitly suggested for single-purpose functions?

options.A: A permanently running interactive desktop session
options.B: A monolithic operating-system administration environment
options.C: Webhook targets
options.D: Lightweight ETL

questions.explanation: Function küçük olay odaklı işlemler, hafif ETL, webhook ve mesaj işleme için uygundur.

questions.question: How are Node.js function dependencies declared in the module's example?

options.A: Only a manually preinstalled VM image
options.B: Only a ZIP containing all installed packages
options.C: In package.json
options.D: In an IAM policy binding

questions.explanation: Node.js bağımlılıkları package.json içinde bildirilir; çalıştırma öncesinde platform tarafından kurulur.

questions.question: Which two statements correctly describe a Cloud Run job?

options.A: It exits when its work finishes
options.B: It can run independent tasks in parallel and retry failures
options.C: It must stay alive after completing all tasks
options.D: It must start an HTTP server and listen on a port

questions.explanation: Job HTTP servisinden farklı olarak işi bitirince çıkar; task'lar paralel çalışabilir ve hatalar yeniden denenebilir.

questions.question: Which product is named for running a Cloud Run job on a regular schedule?

options.A: Cloud Monitoring
options.B: Cloud Tasks
options.C: Cloud Build
options.D: Cloud Scheduler

questions.explanation: Job bir defa, workflow içinde veya Cloud Scheduler ile zamanlı çalıştırılabilir.

questions.question: A developer-focused team wants stateless request handling with minimal infrastructure management. Which option best matches the comparison?

options.A: GKE Standard when node configuration is the main priority
options.B: Cloud Run
options.C: Self-managed Kubernetes on dedicated VMs
options.D: Compute Engine with a self-managed application stack

questions.explanation: Kaynak Cloud Run'ı stateless/serverless ve geliştirici odaklı kullanım için öne çıkarır; her workload için aynı platform şart değildir.

sets.title: Observability services and the four golden signals

questions.question: Which set contains the four golden signals in the module?

options.A: Latency, traffic, errors and saturation
options.B: Errors, request size, project count and availability zone
options.C: Traffic, CPU, storage class and region
options.D: Latency, uptime, disk capacity and budget

questions.explanation: Dört golden signal gecikme, talep miktarı, hata ve kaynak doluluğudur.

questions.question: Why should successful and failed request latency be distinguished?

options.A: Failed requests should never be recorded
options.B: All failed requests are slower than every successful request
options.C: Fast failures can make overall latency look misleadingly healthy
options.D: Successful requests cannot be distinguished from failures

questions.explanation: Hızlı HTTP 500 cevapları ortalama gecikmeyi düşük gösterip sağlıklı işlem performansını gizleyebilir.

questions.question: Which metric best exemplifies traffic for a web server in the course?

options.A: Percentage of memory capacity used
options.B: HTTP(S) requests per second
options.C: Average request duration
options.D: Fraction of requests returning errors

questions.explanation: Traffic sisteme talep miktarıdır; web için saniyedeki istek, veritabanı için read/write sayısı örneklenir.

questions.question: What does saturation measure?

options.A: How many requests arrive per second
options.B: The time required to serve a request
options.C: How full or constrained system resources are
options.D: The fraction of unsuccessful requests

questions.explanation: Saturation kaynakların doluluğunu ve kapasiteye yaklaşmasını ölçer; sistem %100 kullanım öncesinde de yavaşlayabilir.

questions.question: Which service is the closest fit for dashboards, uptime checks and metric-based alerts?

options.A: Cloud Monitoring
options.B: Error Reporting
options.C: Cloud Trace
options.D: Cloud Logging

questions.explanation: Monitoring metric, sağlık/uptime kontrolü, dashboard ve alarm sağlar; diğer ürünler farklı işlemlere yöneliktir.

sets.title: Logging, structured payloads and Ops Agent

questions.question: Which interface is described for SQL aggregate analysis of logs?

options.A: Cloud Trace analysis reports
options.B: Log Analytics
options.C: Logs Explorer only for individual entries
options.D: Error Reporting error groups

questions.explanation: Logs Explorer tekil kayıt incelemeye, Log Analytics SQL ile toplu analize yöneliktir.

questions.question: Which tool streams system logs and metrics from Compute Engine VMs?

options.A: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
options.B: Cloud Trace client
options.C: Ops Agent
options.D: Error Reporting client

questions.explanation: Ops Agent VM log ve metric'lerini toplar; log için Fluent Bit, metric için OpenTelemetry Collector kullanır.

questions.question: Which two statements about Cloud Run stdout/stderr logs match the module?

options.A: Serialized structured JSON is placed in jsonPayload
options.B: JSON logs always lose their searchable field structure
options.C: Every stdout line must first be written to a durable local file
options.D: Text is placed in textPayload

questions.explanation: Cloud Run stdout/stderr loglarını otomatik gönderir; text ve yapılandırılmış JSON payload türleri farklıdır.

questions.question: Which structured-log field sets the log level in the example?

options.A: severity
options.B: message
options.C: component
options.D: logging.googleapis.com/labels

questions.explanation: `severity` özel alan olarak log seviyesine taşınır; `message` görüntülenen ana metin olarak kullanılabilir.

questions.question: You need an alert when occurrences of an error message exceed a threshold over time. What should you create?

options.A: Only a dashboard of VM machine types
options.B: Only a trace for one slow request
options.C: A logs-based metric and an associated alert
options.D: Only a log-based alert on one matching entry

questions.explanation: Tek log deseninde alarm ile zamana yayılan sayım farklıdır; sayım/eşik için logs-based metric uygundur.

sets.title: Prometheus and managed metrics collection

questions.question: How does Prometheus store collected metrics?

options.A: As grouped exception stack traces
options.B: As time-series data
options.C: As container images
options.D: As object versions

questions.explanation: Prometheus metric'leri zaman serisi olarak tutar; trend incelemesi ve alarmda kullanılır.

questions.question: What is the query language named for Prometheus?

options.A: LogQL
options.B: XPath
options.C: SQL
options.D: PromQL

questions.explanation: PromQL metric sorgulama, dashboard ve alarm ifadelerinde kullanılır.

questions.question: What operational burden does Managed Service for Prometheus primarily remove?

options.A: Manually operating and scaling Prometheus infrastructure
options.B: Removing all application instrumentation requirements
options.C: Automatically deciding every service-level objective
options.D: Choosing all business-specific alert thresholds

questions.explanation: Yönetilen hizmet Prometheus altyapısını işletme/ölçekleme yükünü azaltır; iş hedeflerini otomatik belirlemez.

questions.question: Which collector type is recommended for Kubernetes environments in this module?

options.A: Managed collectors operated by a Kubernetes operator
options.B: Only self-deployed collectors maintained manually
options.C: Only application-log text parsing with no metrics collector
options.D: Only periodic manual metric uploads

questions.explanation: Kubernetes ortamlarında managed collector önerilir; işlemleri Kubernetes operator yönetir.

questions.question: Which two interfaces are explicitly named as compatible with the PromQL query API?

options.A: Artifact Registry image viewer
options.B: Cloud Monitoring
options.C: Cloud SQL Workbench
options.D: Grafana

questions.explanation: Managed Service for Prometheus PromQL API kullanan arayüzlerle, örneğin Monitoring ve Grafana ile sorgulanabilir.

sets.title: Error Reporting

questions.question: Which task is Error Reporting specifically designed for?

options.A: Attribute CPU usage to source code
options.B: Manage build artifact vulnerabilities
options.C: Measure per-URL distributed request latency
options.D: Group recurring application errors and explore stack traces

questions.explanation: Error Reporting hata sayımı, gruplama/deduplication, bildirim ve stack trace incelemesi sağlar.

questions.question: How does Error Reporting group and deduplicate errors in the described workflow?

options.A: Group exclusively by VM zone
options.B: Analyze stack traces
options.C: Compare only the event timestamps
options.D: Treat every occurrence as a unique unrelated failure

questions.explanation: Gruplama stack trace analizine dayanır; aynı hatanın farklı olayları bir araya getirilir.

questions.question: Which environment has Error Reporting automatically enabled according to this module?

options.A: Every on-premises process without integration
options.B: Every Compute Engine VM without permissions
options.C: Every GKE cluster regardless of scope settings
options.D: Cloud Run services and functions

questions.explanation: Slayt Cloud Run için otomatik etkinlik belirtir; GKE ve Compute Engine için ek yapılandırma anlatılır.

questions.question: Which IAM role is stated for the service account of a Compute Engine application reporting errors?

options.A: Logging Viewer
options.B: Error Reporting Writer
options.C: Monitoring Viewer
options.D: Error Reporting Viewer

questions.explanation: Compute Engine service account'una Error Reporting Writer rolü verilmesi belirtilir.

questions.question: From an error group's recent sample, what does View Logs open?

options.A: Logs Explorer
options.B: Cloud Monitoring uptime-check editor
options.C: Cloud Profiler flame graph
options.D: Cloud Trace explorer

questions.explanation: View Logs ilgili hata örneğinin log kaydına Logs Explorer üzerinden götürür.

sets.title: Cloud Trace and Cloud Profiler

questions.question: You need to see how request latency is distributed across service calls. Which tool matches?

options.A: Cloud Trace
options.B: Cloud Monitoring uptime checks
options.C: Cloud Profiler
options.D: Error Reporting

questions.explanation: Cloud Trace dağıtık isteklerin gecikmesini ve alt işlemlerini izler; image/secret saklama aracı değildir.

questions.question: How are traces and spans related?

options.A: A trace contains one or more spans for suboperations
options.B: Spans describe only billing periods, not operation timing
options.C: A trace has exactly one span and cannot contain suboperations
options.D: A span always contains every trace in a project

questions.explanation: Trace tek işlemin, span alt işlemin süresini anlatır; trace bir veya daha fazla span içerir.

questions.question: Which approach is recommended when available for detailed application tracing?

options.A: Only writing plain text logs with no trace context
options.B: Only increasing the VM CPU count
options.C: OpenTelemetry with a Cloud Trace exporter
options.D: Only automatic tracing without instrumenting internal calls

questions.explanation: Otomatik HTTP tracing iç servis adımlarını kapsamaz; ayrıntı için uygulama instrumentation'ı ve uygun olduğunda OpenTelemetry önerilir.

questions.question: What does a dot's position represent in the Trace explorer scatter plot?

options.A: Request time and CPU frequency
options.B: Request time and latency
options.C: Error frequency and number of affected users
options.D: Memory allocation and source-code line number

questions.explanation: Grafikte koordinatlar istek zamanı ve gecikmesidir; nokta seçilerek trace/span ayrıntıları incelenir.

questions.question: Which two kinds of information does Cloud Profiler attribute to application source code?

options.A: End-user passwords
options.B: Memory allocation
options.C: Billing-account payment details
options.D: CPU usage

questions.explanation: Düşük ek yükle CPU ve bellek allocation bilgisi toplanıp kaynak kodla ilişkilendirilir; Trace'in istek gecikmesi görevinden farklıdır.

sets.title: Cloud computing characteristics and evolution
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which trait allows customers to provision computing resources without human intervention from the provider?

options.A: A requirement to buy resources before demand is known
options.B: Manual provisioning by a provider's operator
options.C: On-demand self-service
options.D: Long-term fixed hardware allocation

questions.explanation: Self-service kullanıcıların web arayüzünden kaynak almasını, sağlayıcıdan manuel işlem beklememesini anlatır.

questions.question: What does elasticity mean in the course's definition?

options.A: Always reserving maximum capacity for the year
options.B: Keeping a fixed instance count regardless of demand
options.C: Increasing capacity but never reducing it
options.D: Quickly increase or reduce resources as demand changes

questions.explanation: Elastiklik ihtiyaca göre kaynak ekleme ve azaltmadır; yalnız büyüme veya sabit kapasite değildir.

questions.question: Which two traits belong to the five cloud-computing characteristics shown?

options.A: All capacity must be permanently reserved in advance
options.B: Resources are allocated from a shared provider pool
options.C: Access resources over the internet
options.D: Customers must know the exact physical host

questions.explanation: Ağ üzerinden erişim ve sağlayıcının kaynak havuzundan tahsis beş özellik arasındadır; fiziksel konumu bilmek zorunlu değildir.

questions.question: What was rented in the first wave described as colocation?

options.A: A complete end-user SaaS application
options.B: Physical space in a data center
options.C: A managed application runtime with automatic scaling
options.D: A set of serverless functions without any infrastructure responsibility

questions.explanation: Colocation kendi veri merkezi gayrimenkulüne yatırım yerine fiziksel alan kiralama verimliliği sağlar.

questions.question: Which evolution order matches the course?

options.A: Container-based architecture, colocation, virtualized data center
options.B: Virtualized data center, colocation, container-based architecture
options.C: Colocation, virtualized data center, container-based architecture
options.D: Colocation, container-based architecture, virtualized data center

questions.explanation: Doküman bu üç dalgayı sırayla colocation, sanallaştırılmış veri merkezi ve otomatik/elastik container mimarisi olarak anlatır.

sets.title: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and managed services
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which offering provides raw compute, storage and network capabilities?

options.A: PaaS
options.B: A finished web application
options.C: SaaS
options.D: IaaS

questions.explanation: IaaS ham altyapı kaynaklarını verir; Compute Engine örneklenir.

questions.question: Which service model binds application code to libraries that provide access to needed infrastructure?

options.A: IaaS
options.B: Colocation
options.C: PaaS
options.D: SaaS

questions.explanation: PaaS uygulama mantığına odaklanmayı sağlar; kaynakta App Engine örneği verilir.

questions.question: Which pair of examples matches the module?

options.A: Compute Engine: SaaS; App Engine: IaaS
options.B: Compute Engine: IaaS; App Engine: PaaS
options.C: Gmail: IaaS; Compute Engine: PaaS
options.D: Compute Engine: PaaS; App Engine: SaaS

questions.explanation: Compute Engine altyapı, App Engine platform, Gmail/Docs/Drive ise SaaS örnekleridir.

questions.question: What does SaaS deliver to an end user?

options.A: Only raw compute and storage
options.B: A complete application consumed over the internet
options.C: Only physical data-center floor space
options.D: Only application libraries with no completed application

questions.explanation: SaaS bitmiş uygulamadır; kullanıcının altyapı ve platformu kurmasını gerektirmez.

questions.question: What is a stated reason for adopting managed resources and services?

options.A: Eliminate the need to develop application logic
options.B: Require more direct management of physical servers
options.C: Replace business requirements with fixed provider defaults
options.D: Spend less effort maintaining infrastructure and more on business goals

questions.explanation: Yönetilen servisler bakım yükünü azaltıp ürünleri daha hızlı ve güvenilir sunmaya odaklanmayı sağlar.

sets.title: Global network, regions, zones and fault tolerance
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which relationship matches Google Cloud geography in the module?

options.A: A multiregion is a single availability zone
options.B: A zone contains several regions
options.C: A region contains multiple zones
options.D: Every region consists of exactly one zone

questions.explanation: Region bağımsız coğrafi alan, zone region içindeki dağıtım alanıdır; tek bir VM veya proje kavramı değildir.

questions.question: A Compute Engine VM is launched in europe-west2-a. What kind of location is this?

options.A: An organization
options.B: A region
options.C: A multiregion
options.D: A zone

questions.explanation: europe-west2 London region'ıdır; `-a` belirli zone'u gösterir.

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of spreading resources across several zones in one region?

options.A: Automatic translation of the application
options.B: Protection against every region-wide disaster
options.C: Improved fault tolerance
options.D: Guaranteed lower prices in each zone

questions.explanation: Kaynak quiz cevabı temel yararı failure'a karşı dayanıklılık olarak belirtir; indirim veya dil uyarlaması değildir.

questions.question: Which two reasons are given for using resources in several regions?

options.A: Automatically remove all application security risks
options.B: Bring applications closer to worldwide users
options.C: Guarantee lower prices than a single-region deployment
options.D: Protect against an entire region becoming unavailable

questions.explanation: Çok bölge kullanıcıya yakınlık ve bölgesel arızaya dayanıklılık içindir; güvenlik veya ücretsiz kullanım garantisi sağlamaz.

questions.question: Why are content caching nodes placed around the world?

options.A: Force all users to contact the same origin data center
options.B: Respond from locations that reduce latency for users
options.C: Ensure content is stored only in one zone
options.D: Replace durable origin storage entirely

questions.explanation: Dağıtık cache yüksek talep gören içeriği kullanıcıya yakın sunarak gecikmeyi azaltır.

sets.title: Environmental impact and sustainability in the course
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which standard is associated with resource efficiency and waste reduction in the sustainability slides?

options.B: SOC 2
options.D: ISO 9001

questions.explanation: Slayt ISO 14001'i kaynak verimliliği ve atık azaltma çerçevesi olarak anlatır.

questions.question: What cooling resource is used by the Hamina, Finland data-center example?

options.A: Only chilled water produced on every server rack
options.B: Only conventional air conditioning without seawater
options.C: Sea water from the Bay of Finland
options.D: Geothermal steam used directly to cool servers

questions.explanation: Hamina örneğinde Finlandiya Körfezi deniz suyu enerji tüketimini azaltan soğutma yöntemidir.

questions.question: What goal does the slide associate with 2030?

options.A: Achieving annual renewable-energy matching for the first time
options.B: Eliminating the need for any physical servers
options.C: Moving all workloads to a single low-cost region
options.D: Operating on carbon-free energy 24/7

questions.explanation: Bu slayttaki 2030 hedefidir; gerçekleşmiş güncel sonuç şeklinde okunmamalıdır.

questions.question: Which distinction matters in the sustainability timeline?

options.A: The 2030 goal is described as already achieved in every earlier year
options.B: 100% renewable energy and 24/7 carbon-free operation are shown as different milestones
options.C: Carbon neutrality means no electricity is consumed
options.D: Annual renewable matching automatically means carbon-free supply every hour

questions.explanation: Kaynak karbon nötrlüğü, %100 yenilenebilir enerji ve 24/7 karbonsuz enerji hedefini ayrı aşamalar halinde gösterir.

questions.question: Why does the environmental section discuss efficient data-center design?

options.A: Virtualization removes all data-center energy requirements
options.B: Cloud services operate without physical servers
options.C: Only customer devices consume electricity
options.D: Cloud services rely on physical infrastructure that consumes electricity

questions.explanation: Sanal hizmetler fiziksel server ve veri merkezleri üzerinde çalışır; enerji verimliliği bu altyapıyla ilgilidir.

sets.title: Infrastructure security layers
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which two protections belong to the hardware infrastructure level in the course?

options.A: Application-level input validation
options.B: Physical premises security
options.C: Per-request application role assignment
options.D: Secure boot stack

questions.explanation: Donanım katmanında doğru yazılım stack'iyle boot ve fiziksel alan güvenliği anlatılır.

questions.question: Which traffic is explicitly described as encrypted at the service deployment level?

options.A: Infrastructure RPC traffic between data centers
options.B: Only user passwords stored on disk
options.C: Only data stored in backups
options.D: Only the customer's billing export

questions.explanation: Service deployment katmanı veri merkezleri arası altyapı RPC trafiğinin şifrelenmesini vurgular.

questions.question: Which infrastructure component terminates TLS connections and applies DoS protections for internet-facing services?

options.A: Cloud CDN origin storage
options.B: Google Front End
options.C: Cloud DNS
options.D: Cloud Router

questions.explanation: GFE internet hizmetlerinde TLS ve DoS koruması rolündedir; veritabanı index'i veya bütçe aracı değildir.

questions.question: Which two operational-security practices are explicitly listed?

options.A: Monitoring and limiting privileged employee activity
options.B: Two-party review of new code
options.C: Unrestricted privileged access without monitoring
options.D: Shared administrator passwords for all operators

questions.explanation: Kodda iki taraflı review ve yetkili çalışan faaliyetlerinin sınırlandırılıp izlenmesi operasyonel güvenlikte listelenir.

questions.question: Why may Google's identity service ask for additional information during sign-in?

options.A: Risk factors such as an unfamiliar device or location
options.B: A static budget threshold was crossed
options.C: The application's container image grew in size
options.D: The user's project name changed

questions.explanation: Kimlik servisi alışılmadık cihaz/konum gibi risk işaretleriyle ek doğrulama isteyebilir.

sets.title: Open source, open APIs and interoperability
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What concern is the open-source discussion intended to address?

options.A: Only the need for more storage classes
options.B: Only database query latency
options.C: Vendor lock-in
options.D: Only short-term VM capacity shortages

questions.explanation: Açık kaynak ve uygulamayı başka yerde çalıştırabilme sağlayıcı bağımlılığı kaygısını azaltır.

questions.question: Which open-source ML library is specifically named?

options.A: BigQuery
options.B: TensorFlow
options.C: Cloud SQL
options.D: Cloud Build

questions.explanation: TensorFlow ML için açık kaynak kütüphane örneğidir; diğerleri bu örnek değildir.

questions.question: Which two products are named for mixing microservices across clouds?

options.A: Cloud SQL
options.B: Cloud Storage lifecycle management
options.C: Kubernetes
options.D: Google Kubernetes Engine

questions.explanation: Kubernetes ve GKE container/microservice taşınabilirliği ve bulutlar arası çalışmayı destekleyen örneklerdir.

questions.question: Which product family is named for monitoring workloads across multiple cloud providers?

options.A: Cloud Billing Reports
options.B: Cloud Storage versioning
options.C: Artifact Registry
options.D: Google Cloud Observability

questions.explanation: Observability çok bulutlu workload izleme rolünde verilir; image veya veritabanı saklama aynı işlev değildir.

questions.question: What does publishing key technology under open-source licenses give customers in the module's explanation?

options.A: A promise that no provider-specific configuration exists
options.B: Options beyond running exclusively with Google
options.C: A guarantee of zero migration work
options.D: A replacement for all application testing

questions.explanation: Açık kaynak ekosistemi başka sağlayıcı seçenekleri sağlar; sıfır taşıma emeği veya testten muafiyet vaat etmez.

sets.title: Pricing, budgets, reports and quotas
sets.source: fundamentals/M1 _ Introducing Google Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What is the stated purpose of the Google Cloud Pricing Calculator?

options.A: Estimate costs before or while planning resource usage
options.B: Assign resource quotas automatically
options.C: Report only the final invoice after a billing period
options.D: Automatically cap all spending at the estimate

questions.explanation: Calculator maliyet tahminidir; bütçe alarmı veya kaynak durdurma mekanizması değildir.

questions.question: A budget is $20,000 and the alert threshold is 90%. At what spend does the example alert fire?
questions.explanation: 20.000 × 0,90 = 18.000; budget alert bildirim eşiğidir.

questions.question: Which two quota categories are described?

options.A: Budget-percentage quotas
options.B: Allocation quotas
options.C: Storage-class quotas
options.D: Rate quotas

questions.explanation: Rate belirli süre içinde kullanım sayısı, allocation proje kaynak adedi sınırıdır.

questions.question: Which quota resets after a specific time interval in the course?

options.A: A monthly budget amount
options.B: Allocation quota
options.C: A project identifier
options.D: Rate quota

questions.explanation: Rate kota zaman aralığı sonunda yenilenir; allocation mevcut kaynak sayısını sınırlar.

questions.question: Which two cost-management functions are matched correctly?

options.A: Budget alerts always stop all resources automatically
options.B: Reports visualize expenditure by project or service
options.C: Budgets can be defined at billing-account or project level
options.D: Estimates replace actual billing records

questions.explanation: Reports harcamayı görselleştirir, budgets hesap/proje düzeyinde tanımlanır; slayt alarmın kaynakları otomatik durdurduğunu söylemez.

sets.title: Resource hierarchy and project identifiers
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which ordering matches the resource hierarchy from broadest to narrowest?

options.A: Organization, folders, projects, resources
options.B: Folders, organization, resources, projects
options.C: Organization, resources, projects, folders
options.D: Organization, projects, folders, resources

questions.explanation: Organizasyon en üsttedir; folder'lar proje/alt folder içerir, kaynaklar projelere aittir.

questions.question: How many projects does an individual resource belong to in the module's model?

options.A: Every project under the same folder
options.B: No project if the resource is regional
options.C: Exactly two, one for billing and one for compute
options.D: Exactly one

questions.explanation: Kaynak tam bir projeye aittir; projeler ayrı yönetim ve faturalama bölmeleri olarak anlatılır.

questions.question: Which project attribute is user-chosen, need not be unique and can be changed?

options.A: Project ID
options.B: Project number
options.C: The numeric organization identifier
options.D: Project name

questions.explanation: Görünen project name değişebilir ve benzersiz olmak zorunda değildir; ID ve numara farklı özelliklerdir.

questions.question: Which two project attributes are globally unique and immutable after creation?

options.A: Project number
options.B: Project description
options.C: Project name
options.D: Project ID

questions.explanation: Project ID oluşturma sırasında seçilebilir/özelleştirilebilir, sonrasında değişmez; project number Google tarafından atanır ve değişmez.

questions.question: Which two operations are listed for Resource Manager?

options.A: Choose database schemas automatically
options.B: Recover previously deleted projects
options.C: Create projects
options.D: Compile application source code

questions.explanation: Resource Manager proje listeleme, oluşturma, güncelleme, silme ve kurtarma işlemlerini sunar; ML veya parola üretim ürünü değildir.

sets.title: Folders, organizations and IAM policy inheritance
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What is required to use folders in the described hierarchy?

options.A: A Kubernetes cluster
options.B: A billing budget alert
options.C: An organization node
options.D: A VPC peering connection

questions.explanation: Folder kullanımı organizasyon node'u gerektirir; kaynak türleri veya GPU ile ilişkili değildir.

questions.question: Which two items can a folder contain?

options.A: Other folders
options.B: Regions as direct hierarchy containers
options.C: Billing invoices as child resource containers
options.D: Projects

questions.explanation: Folder hem proje hem alt folder içerebilir; departman bazlı hiyerarşi ve delegasyon sağlar.

questions.question: Why place projects managed by the same team under one folder?

options.A: Apply common policies once and inherit them below
options.B: Remove the organization's inherited policies
options.C: Make both projects share one immutable project ID
options.D: Prevent project-specific policies from existing

questions.explanation: Ortak policy'yi folder'a koymak kopya düzenlemeleri ve tutarsızlık riskini azaltır.

questions.question: A principal receives a role on a folder. Where does the resulting allow policy apply in the described model?

options.A: Only the folder's own metadata
options.B: The folder and descendant resources
options.C: Only projects outside the organization
options.D: Only resources created before the grant

questions.explanation: Policy hiyerarşide aşağıya miras kalır; yalnız seçilen tek leaf kaynakla sınırlı değildir.

questions.question: What happens when an applicable deny policy conflicts with an allow grant for the same permission?

options.A: Both policies are ignored when they conflict
options.B: The most recent allow grant always wins
options.C: The deny policy takes precedence
options.D: The broader allow role always wins

questions.explanation: IAM ilgili deny kurallarını allow'dan önce değerlendirir; deny de hiyerarşide miras alınır.

sets.title: Basic, predefined and custom IAM roles
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does an IAM role contain?

options.A: A list of resource billing prices
options.B: A collection of account passwords
options.C: A mapping of zones to regions
options.D: A collection of permissions

questions.explanation: Rol yapılabilen işlemleri temsil eden izinler koleksiyonudur.

questions.question: Which role family is broad in scope in the module's comparison?

options.A: Resource name labels
options.B: Service-specific narrow predefined roles
options.C: Basic roles
options.D: Custom least-privilege roles

questions.explanation: Temel roller geniş kapsamlıdır; predefined ve custom roller daha belirli izin ihtiyaçlarına yöneliktir.

questions.question: Who provides service-specific predefined roles?

options.A: Only each individual project developer
options.B: Google Cloud services
options.C: Only the operating-system package manager
options.D: Only the Cloud Identity administrator

questions.explanation: Predefined roller servislerin sunduğu izin kümeleridir; custom roller kullanıcının özel gereksinimi için oluşturulur.

questions.question: An operator must start and stop VMs but must not reconfigure them. Which option is the closest match?

options.A: A custom role with the required minimum permissions
options.B: Make VM administration anonymous
options.C: Grant every Compute Engine permission
options.D: Grant the broad Owner role

questions.explanation: Kursun instanceOperator örneği start/stop gibi seçili izinler içindir; least privilege gereksiz reconfiguration yetkisini dışlar.

questions.question: At which two levels can custom roles be defined according to the module?

options.A: Project
options.B: Individual VM
options.C: Organization
options.D: Folder

questions.explanation: Custom role tanımı proje veya organizasyon düzeyindedir; folder'da tanımlanamaz. Folder'da kullanım için organizasyon rolü tanımlama önerilir.

sets.title: Service accounts as identities and resources
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: A VM application must access Cloud Storage without end-user involvement. What identity fits?

options.A: The bucket's name alone
options.B: A shared personal password embedded in code
options.C: A service account
options.D: An API key assumed to grant all storage permissions

questions.explanation: Service account workload kimliğidir; VM uygulaması onun verilen yetkileriyle kaynaklara erişebilir.

questions.question: How are service accounts identified in the course?

options.A: By a bucket's globally unique name
options.B: By email addresses
options.C: By a personal password alone
options.D: By a VM's external IP address only

questions.explanation: Service account'lar e-posta biçimli adresle tanımlanır; kişisel kullanıcı parolası yerine workload kimlik mekanizmaları kullanılır.

questions.question: Which statement captures the dual nature of a service account?

options.A: It is both an identity and an IAM-managed resource
options.B: It is only a human user
options.C: It can act as an identity but cannot be managed as a resource
options.D: It cannot have an IAM policy attached

questions.explanation: Service account başka kaynağa erişen kimliktir; aynı zamanda kendi üzerinde policy/rol yönetilebilen kaynaktır.

questions.question: What determines the permissions a VM application receives through its service account?

options.A: The VM's display name
options.B: The programming language chosen
options.C: Roles granted to that service account
options.D: The project's geographic region alone

questions.explanation: Service account'a verilen roller uygulamanın erişimini belirler; dil veya görsel özellikler yetki vermez.

questions.question: Why might two people receive different roles on the same service-account resource?

options.A: Every manager must be an organization owner
options.B: One needs to manage it while the other only needs to view it
options.C: Viewing and management cannot be separated
options.D: Every viewer needs the private key

questions.explanation: Kaynak örneği yönetim ve yalnız görüntüleme ihtiyacını ayırır; service account üzerindeki erişim de IAM ile yönetilir.

sets.title: Cloud Identity and centralized user management
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What problem can arise when a team only uses separate personal Gmail accounts and ad hoc groups?

options.A: Google Groups cannot contain any users
options.B: Every personal account is automatically centrally managed
options.C: There is no central way to manage all team identities and offboarding
options.D: Every project must have the same owner forever

questions.explanation: Kişisel hesaplarla başlayan düzende ayrılan çalışanın erişimini merkezi kapatma zorlaşır; Cloud Identity bu yönetimi merkezileştirir.

questions.question: Which console is used to manage Cloud Identity users and groups in the module?

options.A: Cloud Monitoring console
options.B: Google Admin console
options.C: Cloud SQL administration page
options.D: Cloud Build editor

questions.explanation: Kullanıcı/grup ve policy yönetimi Google Admin console üzerinden anlatılır.

questions.question: Which two offboarding actions are explicitly described?

options.A: Remove the user from groups
options.B: Disable the user's account
options.C: Publish the user's private credentials
options.D: Delete all projects regardless of ownership

questions.explanation: Hesabı devre dışı bırakma ve gruplardan çıkarma çalışan ayrıldığında merkezi erişim yönetimi sağlar.

questions.question: Which existing directory systems are named in the Cloud Identity discussion?

options.A: DNS and BGP
options.B: Active Directory and LDAP
options.C: MySQL and PostgreSQL
options.D: Redis and Memcached

questions.explanation: Slayt mevcut Active Directory veya LDAP kimlikleriyle yönetimden bahseder; cache motorları dizin sistemi değildir.

questions.question: Which editions are named for Cloud Identity?

options.A: Free and premium
options.B: Only an offline edition
options.C: Only premium
options.D: Only a hardware-appliance edition

questions.explanation: Kaynak ücretsiz ve premium sürümleri belirtir; Workspace müşterileri için Admin console'da mevcut olduğunu da söyler.

sets.title: Ways to interact with Google Cloud
sets.source: fundamentals/M2 _ Resouces and Access in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which interaction method is a web-based graphical interface for deploying and diagnosing resources?

options.A: The bq command-line tool
options.B: A Kubernetes manifest alone
options.C: Google Cloud console
options.D: A Cloud Client Library alone

questions.explanation: Cloud console web GUI'dir; kaynak arama, sağlık inceleme, yönetim ve browser SSH gibi işler sunar.

questions.question: Which command-line tool is specifically associated with BigQuery?

options.A: kubectl
options.B: gsutil
options.C: gcloud storage
options.D: bq

questions.explanation: SDK içindeki bq BigQuery aracıdır; gcloud genel Google Cloud arayüzünü sunar.

questions.question: Which two properties describe Cloud Shell in the module?

options.A: A persistent 5-GB home directory
options.B: Requires a local SDK installation first
options.C: Pre-authenticated browser-based command-line access
options.D: Preserves every running VM process indefinitely

questions.explanation: Cloud Shell Debian tabanlı, hazır SDK içeren tarayıcı terminalidir; home kalıcıdır, oturum VM'sinin sonsuza dek yaşaması gerekmez.

questions.question: What does Google APIs Explorer let a developer do?

options.A: Automatically choose every project's billing model
options.B: Discover API versions and try API calls interactively
options.C: Replace all API authorization checks
options.D: Only view API documentation without trying calls

questions.explanation: APIs Explorer erişilebilir API ve sürümleri gösterir, kimlik doğrulama gerektirenler dahil etkileşimli denemeyi destekler.

questions.question: Which two capabilities are explicitly listed for the Google Cloud mobile app?

options.A: Start and stop Compute Engine instances
options.B: Automatically rewrite application source code
options.C: View billing information and budget alerts
options.D: Manage physical data-center hardware

questions.explanation: Mobil uygulama VM/Cloud SQL yönetimi, metric ve faturalama gibi işleri sunar; uygulama şemasını kendiliğinden tasarlamaz.

sets.title: VPC scope and subnets
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which description best matches a VPC?

options.A: An isolated private cloud-computing environment hosted within a public cloud
options.B: A public subnet shared without isolation among all customers
options.C: A physical private data center that the customer must own
options.D: A container runtime with no network functionality

questions.explanation: VPC public cloud içinde özel, izole ağ ortamı sağlar; fiziksel veri merkezi sahipliği gerektirmez.

questions.question: What is the scope of a Google Cloud VPC network in the module?

options.A: Global
options.B: Zonal
options.C: Regional
options.D: Per-instance only

questions.explanation: VPC globaldir; alt ağların kapsamı ise regional'dır.

questions.question: What is the scope of a VPC subnet?

options.A: Regional
options.B: Per-Pod only
options.C: Zonal
options.D: Global

questions.explanation: Subnet bir region içinde farklı zone'lardaki kaynakları bağlayabilir; zone ile aynı kapsam değildir.

questions.question: Which two statements about the subnet example are correct?

options.A: VMs in different zones of the same region can use the same subnet
options.B: Expanding the range always deletes existing VMs
options.C: A subnet's IP range can be expanded without affecting configured VMs
options.D: A subnet necessarily spans every region in a VPC

questions.explanation: Örnek aynı region'ın zone'ları arasında subnet paylaşımını ve mevcut VM'leri etkilemeden aralık genişletmeyi gösterir.

questions.question: Which capability is explicitly included in VPC networking?

options.A: Static routes to specific destinations
options.B: Source-code compilation
options.C: End-user password recovery
options.D: Automatic relational schema conversion

questions.explanation: VPC segmentasyon, firewall ve route işlevlerini içerir; uygulama kodunu veya veri modelini değiştirmez.

sets.title: Compute Engine, VM discounts and storage
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does Compute Engine let users create and run?

options.A: Only stateless HTTP containers
options.B: Only a managed SQL schema
options.C: Only single-purpose event functions
options.D: Virtual machines with full operating-system functionality

questions.explanation: Compute Engine VM sağlar; bir tam OS üzerinde uygulama çalıştırılabilir.

questions.question: Which workload is the best fit for Spot VMs in the course?

options.A: A workload needing uninterrupted capacity with no recovery
options.B: A critical job that cannot resume or restart
options.C: An interruption-tolerant batch job
options.D: A process with unrecoverable state on termination

questions.explanation: Spot VM maliyet avantajı karşılığında kesintiye tolerans gerektirir; batch analiz örneği buna uygundur.

questions.question: What distinguishes a committed-use discount in the module?

options.A: A fee waiver for changing machine names
options.B: A discount earned automatically without any commitment
options.C: A discount obtained only by allowing VM preemption
options.D: A usage commitment for a one- or three-year term

questions.explanation: Committed use belirli kullanım süresi taahhüdüyle ilişkilidir; sustained-use otomatik kullanım indirimiyle karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: Which storage option is described as transient local block storage with high performance?

options.A: Local SSD
options.B: Filestore
options.C: Cloud Storage bucket
options.D: Regional persistent disk

questions.explanation: Local SSD yerel/geçici block storage'dır; persistent disk kalıcı, bucket object, Filestore file storage'dır.

questions.question: Which option is explicitly described as block storage replicated in two zones?

options.A: Local SSD
options.B: Cloud Storage object metadata
options.C: Regional persistent disk
options.D: Zonal persistent disk

questions.explanation: Regional persistent disk iki zone'a replikasyonla belirtilir; local SSD için bu özellik söylenmez.

sets.title: VM scaling and load-aware capacity
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does horizontal scaling change?

options.A: Only the size of an attached disk
options.B: Only the maximum number of IP addresses in a subnet
options.C: The number of VM instances serving the application
options.D: Only the CPU and memory of one existing VM

questions.explanation: Scale out VM sayısını artırıp azaltmadır; scale up tek VM kapasitesini büyütür.

questions.question: What does the described autoscaling feature use to add or remove VMs?

options.A: Load metrics
options.B: The alphabetical order of VM names
options.C: Only the number of IAM users
options.D: Only source repository size

questions.explanation: Autoscaling yük metric'lerine tepki verir; rastgele metadata'ya göre çalışmaz.

questions.question: What complements autoscaling by distributing incoming requests among VMs?

options.A: Identity federation
options.B: Object versioning
options.C: Load balancing
options.D: DNS record versioning

questions.explanation: VM kapasitesi artarken isteklerin bu instance'lara dengeli dağıtılması load balancer ile sağlanır.

questions.question: Which two workloads are specifically mentioned as candidates for very large VMs?

options.A: CPU-intensive analytics
options.B: In-memory databases
options.C: Only user sign-in federation
options.D: Only static object archiving

questions.explanation: Büyük tek VM bellek/CPU yoğun işler için uygundur; modül çoğu müşterinin önce scale out yaklaşımıyla başladığını belirtir.

questions.question: A service moves from four VMs to forty VMs as demand grows. What combination addresses capacity and request distribution?

options.A: Autoscaling plus load balancing
options.B: Only raising a billing budget threshold
options.C: Only changing DNS records with no added capacity
options.D: Vertical resizing of a single VM without request distribution

questions.explanation: Autoscaling kapasiteyi, load balancing gelen trafiğin dağıtımını yönetir; bütçe uyarısı işlem kapasitesi sağlamaz.

sets.title: VPC routing, firewall rules, peering and Shared VPC
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Must a user provision a separate router for the built-in VPC routing tables?

options.A: Yes; internal traffic always requires an external IP
options.B: No; routing tables are built into VPC networking
options.C: Yes; every inter-zone route needs a customer-managed router VM
options.D: Yes; a physical router for each subnet is mandatory

questions.explanation: VPC route işlevi yerleşiktir; kullanıcı ayrı router provision/yönetmek zorunda değildir.

questions.question: Which two traffic directions can the distributed VPC firewall control?

options.A: Outgoing traffic
options.B: Only database query plans
options.C: Incoming traffic
options.D: Only build pipeline stages

questions.explanation: Firewall ingress ve egress trafiğini denetleyebilir; yalnız gelen trafikle sınırlı değildir.

questions.question: What can target a firewall rule at all web-server VMs regardless of their IP addresses in the example?

options.A: A billing-account label
options.B: A network tag such as WEB
options.C: A container image tag alone
options.D: A Cloud Storage object prefix

questions.explanation: Örnek network tag ile VM grubuna port 80/443 kuralı uygular; IP'leri tek tek kodlamak gerekmez.

questions.question: Which feature establishes a relationship between two VPC networks to exchange traffic?

options.A: VPC Network Peering
options.B: Shared VPC host/service-project attachment
options.C: Cloud CDN cache fill
options.D: Cloud Router as a replacement for all VPC connections

questions.explanation: VPC peering iki ağ arasında trafik alışverişi sağlar; diğerleri ağ bağlama özellikleri değildir.

questions.question: Which feature lets one project use another project's VPC under IAM-based control?

options.A: A Cloud Storage bucket ACL
options.B: VPC Peering as shared ownership of one network
options.C: Shared VPC
options.D: A Cloud DNS public zone

questions.explanation: Shared VPC projeler arası ortak ağ ve IAM tabanlı yönetim sağlar; peering ile aynı model değildir.

sets.title: Cloud Load Balancing
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What is the primary job of a load balancer in this module?

options.A: Store application state between requests
options.B: Create more VMs independently of autoscaling configuration
options.C: Authenticate users with federated identity
options.D: Distribute user traffic across application instances

questions.explanation: Load balancing yükü instance'lara paylaştırarak performans sorunlarını azaltır.

questions.question: Which two statements describe Cloud Load Balancing?

options.A: It is a managed, software-defined service
options.B: Customers must manually scale load-balancer VMs
options.C: Every load balancer is restricted to one backend VM
options.D: It can support cross-region load balancing and failover

questions.explanation: Altyapısını kullanıcının yönettiği VM'lere yüklemeden çalışır; tek veya çok bölge trafik yönetimi sağlar.

questions.question: What preparation does the course say is required to pre-warm Cloud Load Balancing for anticipated traffic spikes?

options.A: Manual creation of one load-balancer VM per backend
options.B: Disabling backend health checks before the spike
options.C: No pre-warming is required
options.D: A mandatory pre-warming support request

questions.explanation: Slayt ani yük için ön ısıtma gerekmediğini açıkça belirtir.

questions.question: Which protocol family belongs to an Application Load Balancer in the comparison?

options.A: Only database block replication
options.B: HTTP and HTTPS
options.C: Only BGP route advertisements
options.D: Only arbitrary TCP/UDP traffic without HTTP processing

questions.explanation: Application LB HTTP(S) için, Network LB TCP/UDP ve uygun diğer IP protokolleri için sınıflanır.

questions.question: Which property is associated with a passthrough Network Load Balancer in the explanation?

options.A: Replacing every source address with a proxy address by definition
options.B: Preserving the original source IP address
options.C: Terminating every client connection and opening a new backend connection
options.D: Performing only application-level URL routing

questions.explanation: Passthrough modeli kaynak IP'yi koruma ve direct server return gibi ihtiyaçlarla anlatılır.

sets.title: Cloud DNS and Cloud CDN
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does DNS translate in the course's description?

options.A: Internet hostnames into addresses
options.B: Packets into encrypted disk blocks
options.C: Project names into IAM permissions
options.D: Source code into container images

questions.explanation: DNS isim çözümlemedir; build veya yetki atama sistemi değildir.

questions.question: Which two properties are attributed to Cloud DNS?

options.A: Only manual configuration with no API
options.B: A single nonredundant physical DNS server
options.C: Programmatic zone and record management through CLI or API
options.D: Serving published DNS information from redundant global locations

questions.explanation: Cloud DNS yönetilen, yedekli ve programlanabilir DNS servisidir.

questions.question: What does edge caching do?

options.A: Store content closer to end users
options.B: Store all content exclusively at the original backend
options.C: Replace every application database with RAM
options.D: Rebuild content for every user request

questions.explanation: Edge cache kullanıcıya yakın içerik sunarak uzak origin'e tekrarlı erişimi azaltır.

questions.question: Which two benefits of Cloud CDN are explicitly stated?

options.A: Reduced load on content origins
options.B: Guaranteed removal of all origin storage costs
options.C: Automatic resolution of every application bug
options.D: Lower network latency

questions.explanation: Kaynak düşük gecikme ve origin yükünün azalmasını belirtir; uygulama hatasını veya veritabanı modelini çözmez.

questions.question: Which component is set up before enabling Cloud CDN with the checkbox shown in the module?

options.A: A Cloud SQL replica
options.B: A Secret Manager replication policy
options.C: A Dedicated Interconnect circuit
options.D: An Application Load Balancer

questions.explanation: Bu slayttaki akış Application Load Balancer kurulumundan sonra CDN'yi etkinleştirir.

sets.title: Cloud VPN, route exchange and peering
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does Cloud VPN create in the described hybrid connection?

options.A: A VPN tunnel over the internet
options.B: A public Cloud DNS zone
options.C: Only a dedicated private physical circuit
options.D: A VPC peering relationship with no tunnel

questions.explanation: Cloud VPN internet üzerinden tünel seçeneğidir; dedicated circuit ile aynı bağlantı türü değildir.

questions.question: Which component makes route exchange dynamic for the VPN example?

options.A: Cloud DNS
options.B: Cloud Router
options.C: Cloud CDN
options.D: Cloud Load Balancing

questions.explanation: Cloud Router dinamik rota değişimini sağlar; veri cache'i veya tracing ürünü değildir.

questions.question: Which protocol is used to exchange route information in that example?

options.A: SAML
options.B: OSPF
options.C: BGP
options.D: HTTP

questions.explanation: Border Gateway Protocol ağlar arasında route bilgisini taşır; diğerleri kimlik, sorgu ve görsel metin tespiti alanlarıdır.

questions.question: What infrastructure placement is associated with Direct Peering?

options.A: Only a private database endpoint
options.B: A router in a data center containing a Google point of presence
options.C: Only a service-provider connection without customer PoP equipment
options.D: Only a VPN tunnel over the public internet

questions.explanation: Direct Peering Google PoP bulunan tesiste router ile ağlar arasında trafik alışverişi yapmayı anlatır.

questions.question: Which statement matches the module's description of Carrier Peering?

options.A: It is the same as a Shared VPC host project
options.B: It always supplies a direct private circuit with a guaranteed SLA
options.C: It requires a service-account key to replace routing equipment
options.D: A provider's network connects on-premises to Google services, without a Google SLA for peering

questions.explanation: Carrier Peering servis sağlayıcının ağı üzerinden bağlantıdır; kaynak peering için Google SLA olmadığını belirtir.

sets.title: Dedicated, Partner and Cross-Cloud Interconnect
sets.source: fundamentals/M3 _ Virtual Machines and Networks in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which option supplies direct private connections to Google in the module?

options.A: Cloud VPN
options.B: Dedicated Interconnect
options.C: Direct Peering
options.D: Carrier Peering

questions.explanation: Dedicated Interconnect doğrudan private bağlantı sağlar; peering ve data transfer hizmetiyle karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: What qualification accompanies the up-to-99.99% SLA claim for Dedicated Interconnect?

options.A: Every single circuit automatically has the maximum SLA
options.B: Only the connection name must match a convention
options.C: Connections must use topologies meeting Google's specifications
options.D: All topologies provide the same SLA without requirements

questions.explanation: SLA koşulu belirli topolojilere bağlıdır; tek bağlantıya koşulsuz oran vaat edilmez.

questions.question: A data center cannot reach a Dedicated Interconnect colocation facility. Which supported-provider option fits?

options.A: Cloud VPN as a physical private circuit
options.B: Direct Peering without a provider
options.C: Partner Interconnect
options.D: A Shared VPC service project

questions.explanation: Partner Interconnect desteklenen sağlayıcı üzerinden on-premises ile VPC'yi bağlar; dedicated tesise erişememe örneği verilir.

questions.question: Which option creates dedicated connectivity between Google Cloud and another cloud provider?

options.A: Partner Interconnect to an on-premises site
options.B: Carrier Peering
options.C: Cross-Cloud Interconnect
options.D: Cloud CDN Interconnect

questions.explanation: Cross-Cloud Interconnect başka cloud sağlayıcısıyla yüksek bant genişlikli dedicated bağlantı içindir.

questions.question: Which two Cross-Cloud Interconnect connection sizes are stated in the PDF?

options.A: 10 Gbps
options.B: 100 Gbps
options.C: 100 Mbps
options.D: 10 Mbps

questions.explanation: Yüklenen slayttaki bağlantı boyutları 10 ve 100 Gbps'dir; bu soru belge sürümündeki listeyi ölçer.

sets.title: Object storage, buckets, versioning and lifecycle
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which description distinguishes object storage from block storage?

options.A: Data and metadata are packaged as objects identified by keys
options.B: Fixed-schema relational rows requiring joins
options.C: A hierarchy of mutable files and directories only
options.D: Raw disk sectors addressed as block devices

questions.explanation: Object storage veri+metadata+anahtar modelidir; block storage disk bloklarını sunar.

questions.question: Which two choices are required when creating the bucket described in the course?

options.A: A Kubernetes namespace
options.B: A globally unique name
options.C: A mandatory VM machine type
options.D: A geographic location

questions.explanation: Bucket benzersiz isim ve konumla oluşturulur; konum kullanıcı gecikmesine göre seçilebilir.

questions.question: What does object immutability mean in the course?

options.A: Objects can never be replaced or deleted
options.B: Changing content creates a new object version rather than editing it in place
options.C: Object metadata cannot exist
options.D: All previous versions are retained automatically regardless of settings

questions.explanation: Immutable içerik doğrudan değiştirilmez; replacement yeni sürüm üretir. Bu, hiç yenilenemeyeceği anlamına gelmez.

questions.question: What does enabling object versioning add in the described workflow?

options.A: A guarantee of free storage for all versions
options.B: A requirement to delete previous versions immediately
options.C: The ability to retain and restore older object versions
options.D: Automatic conversion to a relational database

questions.explanation: Versioning eski/noncurrent sürümleri izleyip geri yüklemeyi mümkün kılar; ekstra verinin saklama maliyeti olabilir.

questions.question: Which two policies are examples of lifecycle management in the slides?

options.A: Keep only the three most recent versions
options.B: Delete objects older than 365 days
options.C: Recompile application source code on every read
options.D: Change all IAM roles to Owner

questions.explanation: Lifecycle nesne yaşına/sürüm geçmişine göre saklama-silme yönetimidir; build veya IAM görevi değildir.

sets.title: Storage classes, Autoclass and encryption
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which class is matched with frequently accessed hot data?

options.A: Coldline
options.B: Archive
options.C: Standard
options.D: Nearline

questions.explanation: Standard sık erişim ve kısa süreli saklama için verilir; diğer sınıflar daha seyrek erişim senaryolarıdır.

questions.question: Which class is matched with access about once per month or less?

options.A: Nearline
options.B: Standard
options.C: Coldline as the monthly class
options.D: Archive as the monthly class

questions.explanation: Kaynağın Nearline eşlemesi ayda bir veya daha seyrek erişimdir.

questions.question: Which pair of access patterns matches the uploaded storage-class slide?

options.A: Coldline: daily; Archive: monthly
options.B: Archive: hot data; Standard: annual archives
options.C: Coldline: monthly; Nearline: every 90 days
options.D: Coldline: about every 90 days; Archive: about once per year

questions.explanation: Slayt Coldline için 90 gün, Archive için yılda bir erişim modelini belirtir; erişim örüntüsü ile ürünün farklı ücret kuralları karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: How does Autoclass react to object access patterns in the module?

options.A: Keep every object in its original class regardless of access
options.B: Move unused data colder and accessed data to Standard
options.C: Move accessed data to Archive permanently
options.D: Require manual class selection for every access event

questions.explanation: Autoclass erişim örüntüsüne göre otomatik sınıf geçişiyle yönetim/maliyet yükünü azaltır.

questions.question: Which two encryption facts are stated for Cloud Storage?

options.A: HTTPS/TLS for data in transit between customer and Google
options.B: Unencrypted transport as a mandatory requirement
options.C: Plaintext-at-rest storage as the default
options.D: Server-side encryption before writing data to disk

questions.explanation: Kaynak at-rest server-side şifreleme ve transit HTTPS/TLS'yi ayrı belirtir.

sets.title: Cloud Storage access, transfers and integrations
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What is the course's general access-control guidance for object data?

options.A: Use only the bucket name as an access credential
options.B: Use IAM, with ACLs where finer object-level control is needed and supported
options.C: Treat storage class as the authorization policy
options.D: Make objects public before applying any IAM role

questions.explanation: Kaynak IAM ve gereken durumda ACL ayrımını anlatır. Gerçek kurulumda bucket'ın uniform/fine-grained erişim modu ACL kullanımını etkiler.

questions.question: Does mounting a bucket with a filesystem tool make Cloud Storage fundamentally a native filesystem?

options.A: Yes; it becomes native block storage
options.B: No; it remains object storage exposed through a filesystem-like interface
options.C: Yes; every object becomes an SQL row
options.D: Yes; it removes object immutability entirely

questions.explanation: Araç mount benzeri erişim sağlar; alttaki object storage modeli değişmez.

questions.question: Which service schedules large batch transfers from another provider or HTTP(S) endpoint to Cloud Storage?

options.A: Storage Transfer Service
options.B: Transfer Appliance
options.C: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
options.D: Cloud CDN

questions.explanation: Storage Transfer Service büyük online veriyi farklı kaynaklardan planlı/toplu taşır.

questions.question: What happens in the Transfer Appliance workflow?

options.A: Load data onto a leased device and ship it to an upload facility
options.B: Stream data continuously through a Cloud VPN tunnel
options.C: Move data only through a browser upload form
options.D: Replicate a database solely through SQL queries

questions.explanation: Appliance fiziksel yüksek kapasiteli cihazla taşıma akışıdır; online transfer yönteminden farklıdır.

questions.question: Which two examples of Cloud Storage integration are explicitly listed?

options.A: Store Compute Engine images and startup scripts
options.B: Import/export tables with BigQuery and Cloud SQL
options.C: Automatically convert IAM policies to object versions
options.D: Schedule Pods through object metadata

questions.explanation: Kaynak import/export, VM image ve startup script saklama gibi entegrasyonları sayar.

sets.title: Cloud SQL and Spanner
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which three engines are listed for Cloud SQL?

options.A: SQL Server
options.B: Redis
options.C: PostgreSQL
options.D: MySQL

questions.explanation: Cloud SQL üç ilişkisel motor sunar; Redis/Memcached cache ürünleridir.

questions.question: Which work does Cloud SQL take over from the application team in the module?

options.A: Writing application business logic
options.B: Managing only the browser console while customers patch database servers
options.C: Patching, backups and replication setup
options.D: Designing every table and query automatically

questions.explanation: Cloud SQL rutin veritabanı operasyonlarını yönetir; uygulama mantığını tasarlamaz.

questions.question: Which statement matches Cloud SQL connectivity in the course?

options.A: Only App Engine can connect
options.B: External services are always excluded
options.C: Only the browser console can access database records
options.D: Google Cloud services and external applications can access it through supported connections and drivers

questions.explanation: Cloud SQL hem cloud hem dış istemcilere standard driver'larla erişim sunar; tek arayüzle sınırlı değildir.

questions.question: Which two properties distinguish the Spanner description?

options.A: Only a single fixed-capacity server
options.B: Horizontal scaling
options.C: Strong consistency
options.D: Only eventual consistency with no SQL

questions.explanation: Spanner yönetilen ilişkisel/SQL veritabanıdır; yatay ölçekleme ve güçlü tutarlılık temel ayrımdır.

questions.question: Which scenario best matches the stated Spanner use cases?

options.A: Sub-millisecond in-memory key caching
options.B: Immutable image and video blob storage
options.C: A high-I/O relational application needing joins, secondary indexes and high availability
options.D: A mobile offline document synchronization store

questions.explanation: Slayt SQL, joins/indexes, yüksek erişilebilirlik ve çok yüksek read/write ihtiyacını Spanner'a bağlar.

sets.title: Firestore data model, queries and synchronization
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: How is Firestore data organized?

options.A: Relational tables requiring a fixed global schema
options.B: Raw disk-block offsets
options.C: Only opaque binary objects with no fields
options.D: Documents grouped into collections

questions.explanation: Dokümanlar key-value alanlar taşır; koleksiyonlarda düzenlenir, nested içerik ve subcollection kullanılabilir.

questions.question: Which two query features are listed for Firestore?

options.A: Combining filtering and sorting
options.B: Multiple chained filters
options.C: Mandatory full-dataset scans for every query
options.D: No selective retrieval of individual documents

questions.explanation: Firestore belirli dokümanları veya query'ye uyan koleksiyonu sorgulayabilir; filtre ve sıralama birleşebilir.

questions.question: According to the module, indexed query performance is proportional primarily to what?

options.A: The result-set size
options.B: The amount of unrelated source code
options.C: The size of the entire dataset
options.D: The number of projects in the organization

questions.explanation: Kaynak query performansını tüm dataset yerine sonuç kümesi büyüklüğüyle ilişkilendirir.

questions.question: What happens to local changes when an offline Firestore client reconnects in the described flow?

options.A: They require a manual database export/import
options.B: They are converted into source-code commits
options.C: They are always discarded on reconnect
options.D: They synchronize back to Firestore

questions.explanation: Aktif kullanılan veri cache'lenir; offline read/write/query mümkündür, yeniden bağlantıda yerel değişiklikler senkronize edilir.

questions.question: Which two capabilities are explicitly listed in Firestore's infrastructure features?

options.A: Transaction support
options.B: No transaction support at all
options.C: Atomic batch operations
options.D: Only manual cross-region replication

questions.explanation: Slayt atomic batch, transaction ve strong consistency ile otomatik replikasyonu sayar.

sets.title: Bigtable ingestion, processing and BigQuery distinction
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: Which workload best matches Bigtable in the course?

options.A: A small mobile dataset whose primary need is offline synchronization
options.B: A relational workload requiring multi-table joins
options.C: Large, rapidly changing NoSQL datasets needing high throughput and low latency
options.D: A strongly relational system needing multi-row transactions

questions.explanation: Bigtable büyük, hızlı ve çoğunlukla time-series/anahtar odaklı NoSQL veride hedeflenir; ilişkisel transaction ihtiyacı farklıdır.

questions.question: Which two processing modes are explicitly described for Bigtable data?

options.A: Only browser-based manual editing
options.B: Streaming processing
options.C: Batch processing
options.D: Only physical appliance import

questions.explanation: Kaynak stream için Dataflow/Spark Streaming/Storm, batch için Hadoop MapReduce/Dataflow/Spark örnekleri verir.

questions.question: Which framework is shown specifically among streaming examples?

options.A: Storm
options.B: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy
options.C: Hadoop MapReduce as the streaming example
options.D: SQL Server Management Studio

questions.explanation: Storm stream listesinde yer alır; diğer seçenekler Bigtable stream processing framework'ü olarak verilmez.

questions.question: Which interface is named in the API-based Bigtable access examples?

options.A: A SAML identity-provider endpoint
options.B: A Cloud DNS zone transfer
options.C: HBase REST Server
options.D: An IAM deny-policy editor

questions.explanation: HBase REST Server veya HBase client kullanan Java server veri servis katmanına örnektir.

questions.question: Why is BigQuery distinguished from Bigtable in the module?

options.A: BigQuery emphasizes analytics and interactive querying, beyond pure storage
options.B: BigQuery is simply a second name for Bigtable
options.C: Bigtable is only an object-archive service
options.D: BigQuery exists only to provide sub-millisecond per-key lookups

questions.explanation: İsim benzerliğine rağmen ürünler farklıdır; BigQuery veri işleme/analitik sorgulamaya odaklanır.

sets.title: Choosing among storage products
sets.source: fundamentals/M4 _ Storage in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: An application needs immutable binary objects such as photos and videos. Which product matches?

options.A: Firestore as binary-object hosting
options.B: Cloud Storage
options.C: Cloud SQL
options.D: Spanner

questions.explanation: Blob ve medya nesneleri Cloud Storage kullanımına uyar; ilişkisel veya metric ürünü gerektirmez.

questions.question: An existing web application needs managed relational SQL support with familiar engines. Which product matches?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Bigtable
options.C: Cloud SQL
options.D: Firestore

questions.explanation: Kaynak mevcut uygulama ve web framework'leri için Cloud SQL'i öne çıkarır.

questions.question: An OLTP workload requires relational SQL and horizontal scaling to very large capacity. Which product matches the comparison?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Cloud SQL without horizontal scale requirements
options.C: Bigtable without relational transactions
options.D: Spanner

questions.explanation: Spanner ilişkisel OLTP ve yatay ölçeklemenin birleşimi olarak verilir; object storage veya DNS aynı işi yapmaz.

questions.question: A mobile app needs real-time results and offline query support. Which product matches?

options.A: Cloud Storage
options.B: Bigtable
options.C: Cloud SQL
options.D: Firestore

questions.explanation: Firestore gerçek zamanlı senkronizasyon ve offline kullanım özellikleriyle eşleştirilir.

questions.question: The uploaded comparison table lists 1 MB as the maximum unit size for which product?

options.A: Firestore
options.B: Cloud Storage
options.C: Spanner
options.D: Cloud SQL

questions.explanation: Tabloda Firestore entity için 1 MB, Cloud Storage object için 5 TB belirtilir; bu soru yüklenen tablo sürümüne bağlıdır.

sets.title: Container architecture and microservice scaling
sets.source: fundamentals/M5 _ Containers in the Cloud v5.2 _ ILT.pdf

questions.question: What does a container package in the module's definition?

options.A: Only source code without runtime dependencies
options.B: Application code and its dependencies
options.C: Only an instance template with no executable code
options.D: A complete independent guest operating system for every instance

questions.explanation: Container uygulama kodunu ve bağımlılıklarını sınırlandırılmış çalışma alanında taşır; fiziksel sunucu gerektiren paket değildir.

questions.question: Which two host components are identified as necessary to run containers?

options.A: An OS kernel that supports containers
options.B: A full separate guest OS per container
options.C: A dedicated physical machine for each container
options.D: A container runtime

questions.explanation: Container destekleyen kernel ve runtime host gereksinimleridir; her container ayrı guest OS taşımaz.

questions.question: Why can containers be created quickly in the course's explanation?

options.A: They boot a new guest OS for every process
options.B: They preallocate a full VM for each request
options.C: They require a complete disk-image migration first
options.D: Creation needs only a few system calls and starts like a process

questions.explanation: Container başlangıcı process'e benzer hafif işlemdir; tam VM/OS boot ile aynı değildir.

questions.question: Which action illustrates scaling the same containerized web application horizontally?

options.A: Rebuild the same single instance with a new image tag
options.B: Run additional instances of its container
options.C: Increase only the CPU of its single host
options.D: Rename the existing container without adding instances

questions.explanation: Container kopyaları artırılarak yük karşılanır; isim değiştirmek kapasite eklemez.

questions.question: Which two benefits are listed for an application composed of function-specific containers?

options.A: Every component must scale equally
options.B: Every change requires replacing all hosts together
options.C: Independent scaling across hosts
options.D: Modularity

questions.explanation: Mikroservis container'ları modüler olur ve bağımsız ölçeklenir; tüm bileşenlerin aynı şekilde büyümesi gerekmez.

sets.title: Pods, Deployments, Services and rollouts

questions.question: What is the smallest unit Kubernetes creates or deploys in this module?

options.A: A cluster
options.B: A Deployment
options.C: A Pod
options.D: A node pool

questions.explanation: Pod bir veya daha fazla container'ın birlikte çalışan en küçük dağıtım birimidir.

questions.question: When is placing multiple containers in one Pod particularly appropriate in the course?

options.A: When they need completely isolated networking
options.B: When they must reside on different nodes
options.C: When they have a hard dependency and should share networking/storage
options.D: When they are unrelated and must scale independently

questions.explanation: Sıkı bağımlı container'lar aynı Pod'da ağ/depolama paylaşabilir; ilgisiz uygulamaları bir araya getirmek amaç değildir.

questions.question: Which object manages replicas of a Pod and keeps them running despite node failures?

options.A: Deployment
options.B: Ingress
options.C: Node pool
options.D: Service

questions.explanation: Deployment istenen replica grubunu yönetir; tekil Pod'ların yaşamından daha kalıcı bir desired-state tanımıdır.

questions.question: Which object provides a stable endpoint while Pod IP addresses change over time?

options.A: The container image's registry address
options.B: Service
options.C: A Deployment's source filename
options.D: The individual Pod IP

questions.explanation: Slayt 11 başlığı yanıltıcıdır; açıklama ve s.12 sabit endpoint'in Service'e ait olduğunu, Pod IP'lerinin değiştiğini belirtir.

questions.question: Which two operations match the module's command examples?

options.A: kubectl scale changes a Deployment's replica count
options.B: bq query changes replica counts
options.C: kubectl apply -f applies a configuration file
options.D: gcloud storage cp triggers a rolling update

sets.title: Managed GKE, Autopilot and Standard

questions.question: What underlying resources form a GKE cluster in the module?

options.A: App Engine instances
options.B: Compute Engine instances

options.D: Cloud Run revisions

questions.explanation: GKE cluster'ı Compute Engine makinelerinin gruplandırılmasıyla anlatılır.

options.A: Only the artifact registry

options.D: Every application's business logic

questions.explanation: GKE control plane provisioning ve yönetimini üstlenir; node sorumluluğu seçilen moda göre değişir.

options.B: Whenever a Deployment has more than one replica

options.D: When specific infrastructure configuration control is required

questions.explanation: Autopilot varsayılan öneridir; Standard'ın özel altyapı kontrolü gerçekten gerekiyorsa seçilir.

questions.question: Which two cluster-management benefits are explicitly listed?

options.A: Automatic cluster-node-count scaling

options.C: Requiring customers to manage control-plane VMs
options.D: Node auto-repair

questions.explanation: GKE node sağlık/bakım ve node sayısı ölçekleme gibi özellikler sunar; uygulama hatalarını otomatik yok etmez.

questions.question: Which command in the module creates an Autopilot cluster?

options.A: gcloud container clusters create-auto k1 --region $CLUSTER_REGION
options.B: kubectl get services
options.C: gcloud compute instances create k1

sets.title: Cloud Run request handling and deployment workflows

options.A: Remove infrastructure-management tasks from the developer

options.C: Run stateless containers
options.D: Mandatory customer management of every host VM

questions.explanation: Cloud Run stateless container'ları yönetilen altyapıda çalıştırır; dil seçimi container sözleşmesine bağlı olarak esnektir.

questions.question: Which open technology is named as the basis for the Cloud Run discussion?

options.A: HBase

options.C: Apache Storm
options.D: Docker Swarm

questions.explanation: Kaynak Knative'ı Kubernetes üzerine kurulu açık API/runtime olarak adlandırır; tarihsel platform anlatımı güncel ürün adlarıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

questions.question: What is the order of the container-based development workflow?

questions.question: What does the source-based workflow use to package an application?

options.A: Cloud Router
options.B: Artifact Analysis

questions.question: Which compatibility requirement is stated for a binary in the container example?

options.A: Compiled for Linux 64-bit

options.D: Compiled only for Java

sets.title: Cloud Run functions and event-driven applications

questions.question: Which workload best matches Cloud Run functions in the module?

options.A: A non-event-driven physical network appliance
options.B: A permanently interactive desktop session
options.C: A continuously administered general-purpose OS
options.D: Resize an image when a new file is uploaded

questions.explanation: Görsel yükleme sonrası dönüştürme/thumbnail gibi tek amaçlı olay işleme function örneğidir.

questions.question: Which two services are listed as asynchronous event sources for functions?

options.A: Pub/Sub

questions.question: What programming unit should a function generally implement according to the module?
